patient.name: Maria Haddad
patient.plain: You were treated for a lung infection. Your lungs are healing, but you need to finish your antibiotics, rest, and watch your breathing closely for the next two weeks.

checklist: Breathing exercises with spirometer — 10 breaths, every 2 hours
Drink at least 8 glasses of water
Short walk around the home, 3 times

flags.title: Metoprolol duration not stated
flags.detail: The report lists Metoprolol but not whether it's new or long-term. Ask your doctor before stopping.

flags.title: Conflicting antibiotic dose
flags.detail: Page 2 says 875 mg twice daily; page 4 says 500 mg three times daily.

flags.title: No guidance on returning to work
flags.detail: The discharge note does not mention when normal activity can resume.

warnings: Fever above 38.5°C after 3 days of antibiotics
